verdict.rationale: Hatchet publishes a first-party cookbook describing how to expose Hatchet workflows/tasks as MCP tools that agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK) can invoke, and a runtime probe confirms this cookbook page is live and agent-legible. However, this is a documented integration pattern/cookbook rather than a clearly packaged, maintained 'official MCP server' artifact with setup/connection instructions, versioning, or independent corroboration of real-world use. Missing for 10: a concrete shipped MCP server package/binary with install instructions, independent/community confirmation of agents successfully connecting via it, and clarity on server maintenance/support status.
